question: I would like to compare the changes in the number of contract records under different currency scopes between Q1 and Q4 of 2025, starting with the top 3 currency scopes with the most noticeable changes.
SQL: SELECT t.A_OBJECTSSUMTYPE, SUM(CASE WHEN STR_TO_DATE(CAST(t.ERDAT AS CHAR), '%Y%m%d') >= '2025-01-01' AND STR_TO_DATE(CAST(t.ERDAT AS CHAR), '%Y%m%d') < '2025-04-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS curr_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN STR_TO_DATE(CAST(t.ERDAT AS CHAR), '%Y%m%d') >= '2025-10-01' AND STR_TO_DATE(CAST(t.ERDAT AS CHAR), '%Y%m%d') < '2026-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS prev_cnt, ( SUM(CASE WHEN STR_TO_DATE(CAST(t.ERDAT AS CHAR), '%Y%m%d') >= '2025-01-01' AND STR_TO_DATE(CAST(t.ERDAT AS CHAR), '%Y%m%d') < '2025-04-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN STR_TO_DATE(CAST(t.ERDAT AS CHAR), '%Y%m%d') >= '2025-10-01' AND STR_TO_DATE(CAST(t.ERDAT AS CHAR), '%Y%m%d') < '2026-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ) AS delta_cnt FROM ods_klerp.efi_cms_zp0fiaif0017s t WHERE t.A_OBJECTSSUMTYPE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.A_OBJECTSSUMTYPE ORDER BY delta_cnt DESC LIMIT 3;

question: I'd like to identify, within the Q1 2025 window, the peak days where the contract transaction record volume surged abnormally, and see which dates are significantly above the normal level of the preceding week.
SQL: WITH daily AS ( SELECT STR_TO_DATE(CAST(t.ERDAT AS CHAR), '%Y%m%d') AS d, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ods_klerp.efi_cms_zp0fiaif0017s t WHERE STR_TO_DATE(CAST(t.ERDAT AS CHAR), '%Y%m%d') >= '2025-01-01' AND STR_TO_DATE(CAST(t.ERDAT AS CHAR), '%Y%m%d') < '2025-04-01' GROUP BY STR_TO_DATE(CAST(t.ERDAT AS CHAR), '%Y%m%d') ), ma AS ( SELECT d, cnt, AVG(cnt) OVER (ORDER BY d ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS prev_7d_avg FROM daily ) SELECT d, cnt, prev_7d_avg FROM ma WHERE prev_7d_avg IS NOT NULL AND cnt > prev_7d_avg ORDER BY (cnt - prev_7d_avg) DESC;

question: I want to check the quality of the device master data mapping: are there any cases where the same UNIT_ID corresponds to multiple different device codes? Please provide the first 10 results.
SQL: SELECT t.UNIT_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT t.UNIT_CODE) AS external_cnt FROM 炼化.pm_unit_t t GROUP BY t.UNIT_ID HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.UNIT_CODE) > 1 ORDER BY external_cnt DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Show the device name with the highest design capacity for each device type.
SQL: WITH ranked AS ( SELECT t.UNIT_TYPE_ID AS topic, t.UNIT_NAME AS entity_name, t.CAPACITY AS qty, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t.UNIT_TYPE_ID ORDER BY t.CAPACITY DESC, t.UNIT_NAME) AS rn FROM 炼化.pm_unit_t t WHERE t.UNIT_TYPE_ID IS NOT NULL AND t.UNIT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND t.CAPACITY IS NOT NULL ) SELECT topic, entity_name, qty FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY qty DESC;
